20	from vllm.entrypoints.launchers.dp_supervisor import run_dp_supervisor
21	from vllm.entrypoints.launchers.launcher import create_server_socket

31	from vllm.v1.utils import (
32	    APIServerProcessManager,
33	    RustFrontendProcessManager,
34	    wait_for_completion_or_failure,
35	)

37	logger = init_logger(__name__)
38	
39	DESCRIPTION = """Launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server to serve LLM
40	completions via HTTP. Defaults to Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B if no model is specified.
41	
42	Search by using: `--help=<ConfigGroup>` to explore options by section (e.g.,
43	--help=ModelConfig, --help=Frontend)
44	  Use `--help=all` to show all available flags at once.
45	"""
46	
47	
48	class ServeSubcommand(CLISubcommand):
49	    """The `serve` subcommand for the vLLM CLI."""
50	
51	    name = "serve"
52	
53	    @staticmethod
54	    def cmd(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
55	        # If model is specified in CLI (as positional arg), it takes precedence
56	        if hasattr(args, "model_tag") and args.model_tag is not None:
57	            args.model = args.model_tag
58	
59	        if getattr(args, "grpc", False):
60	            from vllm.entrypoints.launchers.grpc_server import serve_grpc
61	
62	            uvloop.run(serve_grpc(args))
63	            return
64	
65	        rust_frontend_path = (
66	            envs.VLLM_RUST_FRONTEND_PATH if envs.VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND else None
67	        )
68	
69	        if args.headless:
70	            if args.api_server_count is not None and args.api_server_count > 0:
71	                raise ValueError(
72	                    f"--api-server-count={args.api_server_count} cannot be "
73	                    "used with --headless (no API servers are started in "
74	                    "headless mode)."
75	                )
76	            # Default to 0 in headless mode (no API servers)
77	            args.api_server_count = 0
78	
79	        # Detect LB mode for defaulting api_server_count.
80	        # Multi-port: --data-parallel-multi-port-external-lb
81	        # External LB: --data-parallel-external-lb or --data-parallel-rank
82	        # Hybrid LB: --data-parallel-hybrid-lb or --data-parallel-start-rank
83	        is_external_lb = (
84	            args.data_parallel_external_lb or args.data_parallel_rank is not None
85	        )
86	
87	        # If --data_parallel_multi_port_external_lb and --data_parallel_hybrid_lb
88	        # are unset, default to hybrid if --data-parallel-start-rank is set
89	        is_hybrid_lb = is_multi_port = False
90	        if (
91	            not args.data_parallel_hybrid_lb
92	            and not args.data_parallel_multi_port_external_lb
93	        ):
94	            is_hybrid_lb = args.data_parallel_start_rank is not None
95	        else:
96	            is_hybrid_lb = args.data_parallel_hybrid_lb
97	            is_multi_port = args.data_parallel_multi_port_external_lb
98	
99	        if sum([is_multi_port, is_external_lb, is_hybrid_lb]) > 1:
100	            raise ValueError(
101	                "Cannot use more than one data parallel load balancing mode. "
102	                "Choose one of: --data-parallel-multi-port-external-lb, "
103	                "--data-parallel-external-lb (or --data-parallel-rank), "
104	                "--data-parallel-hybrid-lb (or --data-parallel-start-rank)."
105	            )
106	
107	        # Default api_server_count if not explicitly set.
108	        # - Multi-port: 1 (supervisor spawns one server per local DP rank)
109	        # - Rust frontend: 1 (not applicable as it's multithreaded)
110	        # - External LB: 1 (external LB handles distribution)
111	        # - Hybrid LB: Use local DP size (internal LB for local ranks only)
112	        # - Internal LB: Use full DP size
113	        if args.api_server_count is None:
114	            if is_multi_port or is_external_lb or rust_frontend_path:
115	                args.api_server_count = 1
116	            elif is_hybrid_lb:
117	                args.api_server_count = args.data_parallel_size_local or 1
118	                if args.api_server_count > 1:
119	                    logger.info(
120	                        "Defaulting api_server_count to data_parallel_size_local "
121	                        "(%d) for hybrid LB mode.",
122	                        args.api_server_count,
123	                    )
124	            else:
125	                args.api_server_count = args.data_parallel_size
126	                if args.api_server_count > 1:
127	                    logger.info(
128	                        "Defaulting api_server_count to data_parallel_size (%d).",
129	                        args.api_server_count,
130	                    )
131	        elif rust_frontend_path and args.api_server_count > 1:
132	            logger.warning(
133	                "Ignoring --api-server-count=%d when using rust front-end process",
134	                args.api_server_count,
135	            )
136	            args.api_server_count = 1
137	
138	        # Elastic EP currently only supports running with at most one API server.
139	        if getattr(args, "enable_elastic_ep", False) and args.api_server_count > 1:
140	            logger.warning(
141	                "Elastic EP only supports running with with at most one API server. "
142	                "Capping api_server_count from %d to 1.",
143	                args.api_server_count,
144	            )
145	            args.api_server_count = 1
146	
147	        if is_multi_port:
148	            run_dp_supervisor(args)
149	        elif args.api_server_count < 1:
150	            run_headless(args)
151	        elif args.api_server_count > 1 or rust_frontend_path:
152	            run_multi_api_server(args)
153	        else:
154	            # Single API server (this process).
155	            args.api_server_count = None
156	            uvloop.run(run_server(args))
157	
158	    def validate(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
159	        validate_parsed_serve_args(args)
160	
161	    def subparser_init(
162	        self, subparsers: argparse._SubParsersAction
163	    ) -> FlexibleArgumentParser:
164	        serve_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
165	            self.name,
166	            help="Launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server to serve LLM "
167	            "completions via HTTP.",
168	            description=DESCRIPTION,
169	            usage="vllm serve [model_tag] [options]",
170	        )
171	
172	        serve_parser = make_arg_parser(serve_parser)
173	        serve_parser.epilog = VLLM_SUBCMD_PARSER_EPILOG.format(subcmd=self.name)
174	        return serve_parser
175	
176	
177	def cmd_init() -> list[CLISubcommand]:
178	    return [ServeSubcommand()]
179	
180	
181	def run_headless(args: argparse.Namespace):
182	    if args.api_server_count > 1:
183	        raise ValueError("api_server_count can't be set in headless mode")
184	
185	    if args.reasoning_parser_plugin and len(args.reasoning_parser_plugin) > 3:
186	        ReasoningParserManager.import_reasoning_parser(args.reasoning_parser_plugin)
187	
188	    # Create the EngineConfig.
189	    engine_args = vllm.AsyncEngineArgs.from_cli_args(args)
190	    propagate_flash_late_interaction(args, engine_args)
191	    usage_context = UsageContext.OPENAI_API_SERVER
192	    vllm_config = engine_args.create_engine_config(
193	        usage_context=usage_context, headless=True
194	    )
195	
196	    if engine_args.data_parallel_hybrid_lb:
197	        raise ValueError("data_parallel_hybrid_lb is not applicable in headless mode")
198	
199	    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
200	    local_engine_count = parallel_config.data_parallel_size_local
201	
202	    if local_engine_count <= 0:
203	        raise ValueError("data_parallel_size_local must be > 0 in headless mode")
204	
205	    shutdown_requested = False
206	
207	    # Catch SIGTERM and SIGINT to allow graceful shutdown.
208	    def signal_handler(signum, frame):
209	        nonlocal shutdown_requested
210	        logger.debug("Received %d signal.", signum)
211	        if not shutdown_requested:
212	            shutdown_requested = True
213	            raise SystemExit
214	
215	    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler)
216	    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)
217	
218	    if parallel_config.node_rank_within_dp > 0:
219	        from vllm.version import __version__ as VLLM_VERSION
220	
221	        # Run headless workers (for multi-node PP/TP).
222	        host = parallel_config.master_addr
223	        head_node_address = f"{host}:{parallel_config.master_port}"
224	        logger.info(
225	            "Launching vLLM (v%s) headless multiproc executor, "
226	            "with head node address %s for torch.distributed process group.",
227	            VLLM_VERSION,
228	            head_node_address,
229	        )
230	
231	        executor = MultiprocExecutor(vllm_config, monitor_workers=False)
232	        executor.start_worker_monitor(inline=True)
233	        return
234	
235	    host = parallel_config.data_parallel_master_ip
236	    port = parallel_config.data_parallel_rpc_port
237	    handshake_address = get_tcp_uri(host, port)
238	
239	    logger.info(
240	        "Launching %d data parallel engine(s) in headless mode, "
241	        "with head node address %s.",
242	        local_engine_count,
243	        handshake_address,
244	    )
245	
246	    # Create the engines.
247	    engine_manager = CoreEngineProcManager(
248	        local_engine_count=local_engine_count,
249	        start_index=vllm_config.parallel_config.data_parallel_rank,
250	        local_start_index=0,
251	        vllm_config=vllm_config,
252	        local_client=False,
253	        handshake_address=handshake_address,
254	        executor_class=Executor.get_class(vllm_config),
255	        log_stats=not engine_args.disable_log_stats,
256	    )
257	
258	    try:
259	        engine_manager.monitor_engine_liveness()
260	    finally:
261	        timeout = None
262	        if shutdown_requested:
263	            timeout = vllm_config.shutdown_timeout
264	            logger.info("Waiting up to %d seconds for processes to exit", timeout)
265	        engine_manager.shutdown(timeout=timeout)
266	        logger.info("Shutting down.")
267	
268	
269	def run_multi_api_server(args: argparse.Namespace):
270	    assert not args.headless
271	    rust_frontend_path = (
272	        envs.VLLM_RUST_FRONTEND_PATH if envs.VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND else None
273	    )
274	    num_api_servers: int = args.api_server_count
275	    assert num_api_servers > 0
276	
277	    if rust_frontend_path and num_api_servers > 1:
278	        raise ValueError(
279	            "VLLM_RUST_FRONTEND_PATH does not support api_server_count > 1"
280	        )
281	
282	    if num_api_servers > 1:
283	        setup_multiprocess_prometheus()
284	
285	    shutdown_requested = False
286	
287	    # Catch SIGTERM and SIGINT to allow graceful shutdown.
288	    def signal_handler(signum, frame):
289	        nonlocal shutdown_requested
290	        logger.debug("Received %d signal.", signum)
291	        if not shutdown_requested:
292	            shutdown_requested = True
293	            raise SystemExit
294	
295	    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler)
296	    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)
297	
298	    listen_address, sock = setup_server(args, reuse_port=num_api_servers > 1)
299	    # `--grpc-port` is only accepted for the Rust frontend, which inherits this
300	    # listener like the HTTP one. gRPC follows the HTTP TCP host, or IPv4
301	    # loopback when HTTP uses a Unix socket.
302	    grpc_sock = None
303	    if args.grpc_port is not None:
304	        grpc_host = "127.0.0.1" if args.uds else (args.host or "")
305	        grpc_sock = create_server_socket((grpc_host, args.grpc_port), reuse_port=False)
306	
307	    engine_args = vllm.AsyncEngineArgs.from_cli_args(args)
308	    propagate_flash_late_interaction(args, engine_args)
309	    engine_args._api_process_count = num_api_servers
310	    engine_args._api_process_rank = -1
311	
312	    usage_context = UsageContext.OPENAI_API_SERVER
313	    vllm_config = engine_args.create_engine_config(usage_context=usage_context)
314	
315	    if num_api_servers > 1 and envs.VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING:
316	        raise ValueError(
317	            "VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING cannot be used with api_server_count > 1"
318	        )
319	
320	    executor_class = Executor.get_class(vllm_config)
321	    log_stats = not engine_args.disable_log_stats
322	
323	    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
324	    dp_rank = parallel_config.data_parallel_rank
325	    assert parallel_config.local_engines_only or dp_rank == 0
326	
327	    api_server_manager: APIServerProcessManager | RustFrontendProcessManager | None = (
328	        None
329	    )
330	
331	    from vllm.v1.engine.utils import bind_engine_zmq_listeners
332	
333	    zmq_listeners = bind_engine_zmq_listeners(vllm_config, num_api_servers)
334	    addresses = zmq_listeners.addresses
335	
336	    with launch_core_engines(
337	        vllm_config, executor_class, log_stats, addresses
338	    ) as engine_launch:
339	        local_engine_manager = engine_launch.engine_manager
340	        coordinator = engine_launch.coordinator
341	        addresses = engine_launch.addresses
342	        stats_update_address = (
343	            coordinator.get_stats_publish_address() if coordinator else None
344	        )
345	
346	        if rust_frontend_path:
347	            if parallel_config.local_engines_only:
348	                expected_engine_start_index = parallel_config.data_parallel_rank
349	                expected_engine_count = parallel_config.data_parallel_size_local
350	            else:
351	                expected_engine_start_index = 0
352	                expected_engine_count = parallel_config.data_parallel_size
353	            # Start rust front-end process.
354	            api_server_manager = RustFrontendProcessManager(
355	                binary_path=rust_frontend_path,
356	                sock=sock,
357	                grpc_sock=grpc_sock,
358	                args=args,
359	                input_listener=zmq_listeners.inputs[0],
360	                output_listener=zmq_listeners.outputs[0],
361	                engine_start_index=expected_engine_start_index,
362	                engine_count=expected_engine_count,
363	                data_parallel_size=parallel_config.data_parallel_size,
364	                stats_update_address=stats_update_address,
365	            )
366	        else:
367	            # Start API server(s).
368	            api_server_manager = APIServerProcessManager(
369	                listen_address=listen_address,
370	                sock=sock,
371	                args=args,
372	                num_servers=num_api_servers,
373	                input_listeners=zmq_listeners.inputs,
374	                output_listeners=zmq_listeners.outputs,
375	                stats_update_address=stats_update_address,
376	                tensor_queue=engine_launch.tensor_queue,
377	            )
378	
379	        # Set frontend processes to watch during engine startup.
380	        # If any of these processes exit before the engines are up, the engine startup
381	        # will be aborted with an error.
382	        engine_launch.watched_frontend_processes = api_server_manager.processes
383	
384	    # Wait for API servers.
385	    try:
386	        wait_for_completion_or_failure(
387	            api_server_manager=api_server_manager,
388	            engine_manager=local_engine_manager,
389	            coordinator=coordinator,
390	        )
391	    finally:
392	        timeout = shutdown_by = None

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project

import argparse
import signal
import time

import uvloop

import vllm
import vllm.envs as envs
from vllm.entrypoints.cli.types import CLISubcommand
from vllm.entrypoints.common.cli_args import (
    make_arg_parser,
    propagate_flash_late_interaction,
    validate_parsed_serve_args,
)
from vllm.entrypoints.common.startup import VLLM_SUBCMD_PARSER_EPILOG
from vllm.entrypoints.launchers.api_server.entry import run_server, setup_server
from vllm.entrypoints.launchers.dp_supervisor import run_dp_supervisor
from vllm.entrypoints.launchers.launcher import create_server_socket
from vllm.logger import init_logger
from vllm.reasoning import ReasoningParserManager
from vllm.usage.usage_lib import UsageContext
from vllm.utils.argparse_utils import FlexibleArgumentParser
from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_tcp_uri
from vllm.v1.engine.utils import CoreEngineProcManager, launch_core_engines
from vllm.v1.executor import Executor
from vllm.v1.executor.multiproc_executor import MultiprocExecutor
from vllm.v1.metrics.prometheus import setup_multiprocess_prometheus
from vllm.v1.utils import (
    APIServerProcessManager,
    RustFrontendProcessManager,
    wait_for_completion_or_failure,
)

logger = init_logger(__name__)

DESCRIPTION = """Launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server to serve LLM
completions via HTTP. Defaults to Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B if no model is specified.

Search by using: `--help=<ConfigGroup>` to explore options by section (e.g.,
--help=ModelConfig, --help=Frontend)
  Use `--help=all` to show all available flags at once.
"""


class ServeSubcommand(CLISubcommand):
    """The `serve` subcommand for the vLLM CLI."""

    name = "serve"

    @staticmethod
    def cmd(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
        # If model is specified in CLI (as positional arg), it takes precedence
        if hasattr(args, "model_tag") and args.model_tag is not None:
            args.model = args.model_tag

        if getattr(args, "grpc", False):
            from vllm.entrypoints.launchers.grpc_server import serve_grpc

            uvloop.run(serve_grpc(args))
            return

        rust_frontend_path = (
            envs.VLLM_RUST_FRONTEND_PATH if envs.VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND else None
        )

        if args.headless:
            if args.api_server_count is not None and args.api_server_count > 0:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"--api-server-count={args.api_server_count} cannot be "
                    "used with --headless (no API servers are started in "
                    "headless mode)."
                )
            # Default to 0 in headless mode (no API servers)
            args.api_server_count = 0

        # Detect LB mode for defaulting api_server_count.
        # Multi-port: --data-parallel-multi-port-external-lb
        # External LB: --data-parallel-external-lb or --data-parallel-rank
        # Hybrid LB: --data-parallel-hybrid-lb or --data-parallel-start-rank
        is_external_lb = (
            args.data_parallel_external_lb or args.data_parallel_rank is not None
        )

        # If --data_parallel_multi_port_external_lb and --data_parallel_hybrid_lb
        # are unset, default to hybrid if --data-parallel-start-rank is set
        is_hybrid_lb = is_multi_port = False
        if (
            not args.data_parallel_hybrid_lb
            and not args.data_parallel_multi_port_external_lb
        ):
            is_hybrid_lb = args.data_parallel_start_rank is not None
        else:
            is_hybrid_lb = args.data_parallel_hybrid_lb
            is_multi_port = args.data_parallel_multi_port_external_lb

        if sum([is_multi_port, is_external_lb, is_hybrid_lb]) > 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot use more than one data parallel load balancing mode. "
                "Choose one of: --data-parallel-multi-port-external-lb, "
                "--data-parallel-external-lb (or --data-parallel-rank), "
                "--data-parallel-hybrid-lb (or --data-parallel-start-rank)."
            )

        # Default api_server_count if not explicitly set.
        # - Multi-port: 1 (supervisor spawns one server per local DP rank)
        # - Rust frontend: 1 (not applicable as it's multithreaded)
        # - External LB: 1 (external LB handles distribution)
        # - Hybrid LB: Use local DP size (internal LB for local ranks only)
        # - Internal LB: Use full DP size
        if args.api_server_count is None:
            if is_multi_port or is_external_lb or rust_frontend_path:
                args.api_server_count = 1
            elif is_hybrid_lb:
                args.api_server_count = args.data_parallel_size_local or 1
                if args.api_server_count > 1:
                    logger.info(
                        "Defaulting api_server_count to data_parallel_size_local "
                        "(%d) for hybrid LB mode.",
                        args.api_server_count,
                    )
            else:
                args.api_server_count = args.data_parallel_size
                if args.api_server_count > 1:
                    logger.info(
                        "Defaulting api_server_count to data_parallel_size (%d).",
                        args.api_server_count,
                    )
        elif rust_frontend_path and args.api_server_count > 1:
            logger.warning(
                "Ignoring --api-server-count=%d when using rust front-end process",
                args.api_server_count,
            )
            args.api_server_count = 1

        # Elastic EP currently only supports running with at most one API server.
        if getattr(args, "enable_elastic_ep", False) and args.api_server_count > 1:
            logger.warning(
                "Elastic EP only supports running with with at most one API server. "
                "Capping api_server_count from %d to 1.",
                args.api_server_count,
            )
            args.api_server_count = 1

        if is_multi_port:
            run_dp_supervisor(args)
        elif args.api_server_count < 1:
            run_headless(args)
        elif args.api_server_count > 1 or rust_frontend_path:
            run_multi_api_server(args)
        else:
            # Single API server (this process).
            args.api_server_count = None
            uvloop.run(run_server(args))

    def validate(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
        validate_parsed_serve_args(args)

    def subparser_init(
        self, subparsers: argparse._SubParsersAction
    ) -> FlexibleArgumentParser:
        serve_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
            self.name,
            help="Launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server to serve LLM "
            "completions via HTTP.",
            description=DESCRIPTION,
            usage="vllm serve [model_tag] [options]",
        )

        serve_parser = make_arg_parser(serve_parser)
        serve_parser.epilog = VLLM_SUBCMD_PARSER_EPILOG.format(subcmd=self.name)
        return serve_parser


def cmd_init() -> list[CLISubcommand]:
    return [ServeSubcommand()]


def run_headless(args: argparse.Namespace):
    if args.api_server_count > 1:
        raise ValueError("api_server_count can't be set in headless mode")

    if args.reasoning_parser_plugin and len(args.reasoning_parser_plugin) > 3:
        ReasoningParserManager.import_reasoning_parser(args.reasoning_parser_plugin)

    # Create the EngineConfig.
    engine_args = vllm.AsyncEngineArgs.from_cli_args(args)
    propagate_flash_late_interaction(args, engine_args)
    usage_context = UsageContext.OPENAI_API_SERVER
    vllm_config = engine_args.create_engine_config(
        usage_context=usage_context, headless=True
    )

    if engine_args.data_parallel_hybrid_lb:
        raise ValueError("data_parallel_hybrid_lb is not applicable in headless mode")

    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
    local_engine_count = parallel_config.data_parallel_size_local

    if local_engine_count <= 0:
        raise ValueError("data_parallel_size_local must be > 0 in headless mode")

    shutdown_requested = False

    # Catch SIGTERM and SIGINT to allow graceful shutdown.
    def signal_handler(signum, frame):
        nonlocal shutdown_requested
        logger.debug("Received %d signal.", signum)
        if not shutdown_requested:
            shutdown_requested = True
            raise SystemExit

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)

    if parallel_config.node_rank_within_dp > 0:
        from vllm.version import __version__ as VLLM_VERSION

        # Run headless workers (for multi-node PP/TP).
        host = parallel_config.master_addr
        head_node_address = f"{host}:{parallel_config.master_port}"
        logger.info(
            "Launching vLLM (v%s) headless multiproc executor, "
            "with head node address %s for torch.distributed process group.",
            VLLM_VERSION,
            head_node_address,
        )

        executor = MultiprocExecutor(vllm_config, monitor_workers=False)
        executor.start_worker_monitor(inline=True)
        return

    host = parallel_config.data_parallel_master_ip
    port = parallel_config.data_parallel_rpc_port
    handshake_address = get_tcp_uri(host, port)

    logger.info(
        "Launching %d data parallel engine(s) in headless mode, "
        "with head node address %s.",
        local_engine_count,
        handshake_address,
    )

    # Create the engines.
    engine_manager = CoreEngineProcManager(
        local_engine_count=local_engine_count,
        start_index=vllm_config.parallel_config.data_parallel_rank,
        local_start_index=0,
        vllm_config=vllm_config,
        local_client=False,
        handshake_address=handshake_address,
        executor_class=Executor.get_class(vllm_config),
        log_stats=not engine_args.disable_log_stats,
    )

    try:
        engine_manager.monitor_engine_liveness()
    finally:
        timeout = None
        if shutdown_requested:
            timeout = vllm_config.shutdown_timeout
            logger.info("Waiting up to %d seconds for processes to exit", timeout)
        engine_manager.shutdown(timeout=timeout)
        logger.info("Shutting down.")


def run_multi_api_server(args: argparse.Namespace):
    assert not args.headless
    rust_frontend_path = (
        envs.VLLM_RUST_FRONTEND_PATH if envs.VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND else None
    )
    num_api_servers: int = args.api_server_count
    assert num_api_servers > 0

    if rust_frontend_path and num_api_servers > 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "VLLM_RUST_FRONTEND_PATH does not support api_server_count > 1"
        )

    if num_api_servers > 1:
        setup_multiprocess_prometheus()

    shutdown_requested = False

    # Catch SIGTERM and SIGINT to allow graceful shutdown.
    def signal_handler(signum, frame):
        nonlocal shutdown_requested
        logger.debug("Received %d signal.", signum)
        if not shutdown_requested:
            shutdown_requested = True
            raise SystemExit

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)

    listen_address, sock = setup_server(args, reuse_port=num_api_servers > 1)
    # `--grpc-port` is only accepted for the Rust frontend, which inherits this
    # listener like the HTTP one. gRPC follows the HTTP TCP host, or IPv4
    # loopback when HTTP uses a Unix socket.
    grpc_sock = None
    if args.grpc_port is not None:
        grpc_host = "127.0.0.1" if args.uds else (args.host or "")
        grpc_sock = create_server_socket((grpc_host, args.grpc_port), reuse_port=False)

    engine_args = vllm.AsyncEngineArgs.from_cli_args(args)
    propagate_flash_late_interaction(args, engine_args)
    engine_args._api_process_count = num_api_servers
    engine_args._api_process_rank = -1

    usage_context = UsageContext.OPENAI_API_SERVER
    vllm_config = engine_args.create_engine_config(usage_context=usage_context)

    if num_api_servers > 1 and envs.VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING:
        raise ValueError(
            "VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING cannot be used with api_server_count > 1"
        )

    executor_class = Executor.get_class(vllm_config)
    log_stats = not engine_args.disable_log_stats

    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
    dp_rank = parallel_config.data_parallel_rank
    assert parallel_config.local_engines_only or dp_rank == 0

    api_server_manager: APIServerProcessManager | RustFrontendProcessManager | None = (
        None
    )

    from vllm.v1.engine.utils import bind_engine_zmq_listeners

    zmq_listeners = bind_engine_zmq_listeners(vllm_config, num_api_servers)
    addresses = zmq_listeners.addresses

    with launch_core_engines(
        vllm_config, executor_class, log_stats, addresses
    ) as engine_launch:
        local_engine_manager = engine_launch.engine_manager
        coordinator = engine_launch.coordinator
        addresses = engine_launch.addresses
        stats_update_address = (
            coordinator.get_stats_publish_address() if coordinator else None
        )

        if rust_frontend_path:
            if parallel_config.local_engines_only:
                expected_engine_start_index = parallel_config.data_parallel_rank
                expected_engine_count = parallel_config.data_parallel_size_local
            else:
                expected_engine_start_index = 0
                expected_engine_count = parallel_config.data_parallel_size
            # Start rust front-end process.
            api_server_manager = RustFrontendProcessManager(
                binary_path=rust_frontend_path,
                sock=sock,
                grpc_sock=grpc_sock,
                args=args,
                input_listener=zmq_listeners.inputs[0],
                output_listener=zmq_listeners.outputs[0],
                engine_start_index=expected_engine_start_index,
                engine_count=expected_engine_count,
                data_parallel_size=parallel_config.data_parallel_size,
                stats_update_address=stats_update_address,
            )
        else:
            # Start API server(s).
            api_server_manager = APIServerProcessManager(
                listen_address=listen_address,
                sock=sock,
                args=args,
                num_servers=num_api_servers,
                input_listeners=zmq_listeners.inputs,
                output_listeners=zmq_listeners.outputs,
                stats_update_address=stats_update_address,
                tensor_queue=engine_launch.tensor_queue,
            )

        # Set frontend processes to watch during engine startup.
        # If any of these processes exit before the engines are up, the engine startup
        # will be aborted with an error.
        engine_launch.watched_frontend_processes = api_server_manager.processes

    # Wait for API servers.
    try:
        wait_for_completion_or_failure(
            api_server_manager=api_server_manager,
            engine_manager=local_engine_manager,
            coordinator=coordinator,
        )
    finally:
        timeout = shutdown_by = None
        if shutdown_requested:
            timeout = vllm_config.shutdown_timeout
            shutdown_by = time.monotonic() + timeout
            logger.info("Waiting up to %d seconds for processes to exit", timeout)

        def to_timeout(deadline: float | None) -> float | None:
            return (
                deadline if deadline is None else max(deadline - time.monotonic(), 0.0)
            )

        api_server_manager.shutdown(timeout=timeout)
        if local_engine_manager:
            local_engine_manager.shutdown(timeout=to_timeout(shutdown_by))
        if coordinator:
            coordinator.shutdown(timeout=to_timeout(shutdown_by))

"""Unit tests for the ``vllm serve`` CLI subcommand."""

import argparse
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

import pytest

from vllm.entrypoints.cli.serve import run_headless


class _StopAfterEngineConfig(Exception):
    pass


def test_headless_imports_reasoning_parser_plugin_before_engine_config():
    plugin_path = "/tmp/custom_reasoning_parser.py"
    args = argparse.Namespace(
        api_server_count=0,
        reasoning_parser_plugin=plugin_path,
    )
    engine_args = MagicMock()

    with (
        patch(
            "vllm.entrypoints.cli.serve.vllm.AsyncEngineArgs.from_cli_args",
            return_value=engine_args,
        ),
        patch(
            "vllm.reasoning.ReasoningParserManager.import_reasoning_parser"
        ) as import_plugin,
    ):

        def create_engine_config(**kwargs):
            import_plugin.assert_called_once_with(plugin_path)
            raise _StopAfterEngineConfig

        engine_args.create_engine_config.side_effect = create_engine_config

        with pytest.raises(_StopAfterEngineConfig):
            run_headless(args)

import argparse
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

import pytest

from vllm.entrypoints.cli.serve import run_headless


class _StopAfterEngineConfig(Exception):
    pass


def test_headless_imports_reasoning_parser_plugin_before_engine_config():
    plugin_path = "/tmp/custom_reasoning_parser.py"
    args = argparse.Namespace(
        api_server_count=0,
        reasoning_parser_plugin=plugin_path,
    )
    engine_args = MagicMock()

    with (
        patch(
            "vllm.entrypoints.cli.serve.vllm.AsyncEngineArgs.from_cli_args",
            return_value=engine_args,
        ),
        patch(
            "vllm.reasoning.ReasoningParserManager.import_reasoning_parser"
        ) as import_plugin,
    ):

        def create_engine_config(**kwargs):
            import_plugin.assert_called_once_with(plugin_path)
            raise _StopAfterEngineConfig

        engine_args.create_engine_config.side_effect = create_engine_config

        with pytest.raises(_StopAfterEngineConfig):
            run_headless(args)
